old_value: {"id":"PKIX-6p6p","title":"pkix-path: anyPolicy expansion produces duplicate PolicyNode entries","description":"Skoll BUGS MEDIUM-1 finding (PKIX-szmo.7 triage). In pkix-path/src/lib.rs around line 3347, the anyPolicy expansion loop builds an already_covered Vec to skip duplicates, but the Vec is a snapshot taken before the loop starts. When two parent nodes have overlapping expected_policy_set (possible after PolicyMappings per RFC 5280 §6.1.4), the loop can insert duplicate PolicyNode entries for the same policy OID at the same tree depth. Fix: move already_covered accumulation inside the loop so each iteration sees nodes added by prior iterations, or use a HashSet of policy OIDs.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-06-04T18:08:21Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-04T18:08:21Z","metadata":{}}
